use default

sift_down[T: Ghul.Comparable[T]](values: LIST[T], start: int, end: int) is
    let root mut = start

    while root * 2 + 1 <= end do
        let child mut = root * 2 + 1

        if child + 1 <= end /\ values[child] < values[child + 1] then
            child = child + 1
        fi

        if values[root] < values[child] then
            (values[root], values[child]) = (values[child], values[root])

            root = child
        else
            return
        fi
    od
si

heap_sort[T: Ghul.Comparable[T]](values: LIST[T]) is
    let count = values.count

    let start mut = count / 2 - 1

    while start >= 0 do
        sift_down(values, start, count - 1)
        start = start - 1
    od

    let end mut = count - 1

    while end > 0 do
        (values[0], values[end]) = (values[end], values[0])

        end = end - 1

        sift_down(values, 0, end)
    od
si

let numbers = LIST([5, 3, 8, 1, 9, 2, 7])

heap_sort(numbers)

write_line(numbers |> join(", "))

let words = LIST(["pear", "apple", "quince", "banana"])

heap_sort(words)

write_line(words |> join(", "))
